lower-middle-income countries. Multidimensional poverty is defined as being deprived in a range of health, education and

tspan.tspan: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2026); Alkire et al. (2025) - The Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) 2025
Extreme poverty data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Depending on the country and year, it relates to income (measured

text.tspan: after taxes and benefits) or to consumption, per capita. Multidimensional poverty is based on the most recent household survey data (between
2013 and 2023). Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2014 and 2026 is shown instead.
